matches.quote: The authors do not justify the exponent, give no fit uncertainties... The authors should report pc with an error bar, compare it with a linear or other fit
No calculation supports the statement... that the P-3m1 / A-A phase "becomes stable" with pressure... compute the enthalpy H = E + pV against pressure for ABC (R-3), A-A
J1 to J3 are ambient-pressure values from Ref. [73]... redo the simulations with pressure-dependent J1 to J3 and JL computed from DFT at the experimental lattice parameters
The caption of Fig. 4 is garbled ("a) ambient pressure, and a) a lower b) and c) lower than the transition temperature"). It should refer to pressures
The measured R-3 phase fraction does not track the magnetic suppression... show quantitatively that the A-A concentration rises across 0 to 6 GPa, or else revise the mechanism.
The caption of Fig. 1 says the field is 0.1 T, while the panel legend and Fig. 3 say 0.01 T (100 Oe). Please correct it.
The novelty statement "first direct experimental evidence" should state precisely what is new. Earlier studies (Refs. [18], [20], [39]) already reported a decrease of Tc under pressure
If P-3m1 / A-A stacking carries antiferromagnetic interlayer coupling, the unloaded crystal should show no spontaneous moment, or a strongly reduced one, at ambient pressure.
the 10 K moments do not track Tc. At 1.1 GPa the 2 T moment falls by ~25%... add at least one pressure between 6.5 and 9 GPa
explain how the phase fraction is extracted (which reflections, how stacking-fault scattering is separated)... show quantitatively that the A-A concentration rises across 0 to 6 GPa
explain physically how antiferromagnetic interlayer coupling on some interfaces can drive Tc toward zero... redo the simulations with pressure-dependent J1 to J3 and JL computed from DFT
The P-3m1 cell... is the average subcell of a honeycomb layer. It describes any stacking in which the position of the honeycomb vacancy is uncorrelated from layer to layer
and do not say how Tc is defined from the 0.01 T M(T) curves (onset, inflection, dM/dT minimum).
The magnetic "pc" (6.5 GPa at low T), the X-ray transition (6.4 to 8.4 GPa at RT) and the Raman "pc" (~10 GPa at RT) are then compared
"Atoms from the AA and AB phases" are distributed at random site by site. Stacking, however, is a property of whole interfaces between layers
The ambient sample already contains ~45% P-3m1 by Fig. 5b... yet at ambient pressure Tc = 33 K and the moment is nearly saturated (2.8 µB).
The P-3m1 cell (Cr at 1a with occupancy 2/3) is the average subcell... state which stacking the DFT value JL = -0.35 meV actually corresponds to.
rewrite the structural sections and conclusions so the P-3m1 average structure, the stacking model, and the structure used in DFT all agree.
